formulas.xpForLevel: function xpForLevel(L){ const base = L<=28 ? 92*Math.pow(1.20, L-1) : 92*Math.pow(1.20, 27)*Math.pow(1.09, L-28); return Math.floor(base * (L>=3 && L<=14 ? 1.1 : 1) * (L>=10 ? 1.11 : 1)); }
formulas.monStdLife: function monStdLife(ml){ const l = Math.max(1, ml); return parHit(l)*(4.5 + 0.1*l)/0.7 * (l >= LATE_LIFE_LV ? LATE_LIFE_MULT : 1); }
formulas.hitLevelFactor: function hitLevelFactor(p, ml){ const pl = Math.max(1, (p && p.level) || 1), m = Math.max(1, ml||1); return pl - m <= HIT_LEVEL_GRACE ? 1 : 2*m/(m + pl - HIT_LEVEL_GRACE); }
formulas.attrBase: function attrBase(cls, key, L){ return CLASS_MAIN_ATTR[cls]===key ? attrMainAtLevel(L) : ATTR_OTHER_START + ATTR_OTHER_PER_LV*(Math.max(1,L||1)-1); }
formulas.evasionChance:
function evasionChance(p){ const sw = (p && p.cls==='mystic' && p.skills && typeof stormWardChance==='function' && (effectiveRank(p,'stormWard')||0)>0) ? stormWardChance(effectiveRank(p,'stormWard')) : 0;   // v568: Storm Ward adds to evasion chance (same 60% cap)
  const base = clamp(gearEvasionNow(p)/100 + evasionSkillChance(p) + sw, 0, EVASION_CAP); return (p.vanishEvaT>0 && typeof VANISH_EVA!=='undefined') ? Math.max(base, VANISH_EVA) : base; }
formulas.dexEvasionTapered: function dexEvasionTapered(dex, lvl){ const raw = dexEvasionPct(dex, lvl); return Math.round(10*Math.min(DEX_DODGE_CAP, raw <= DEX_EVA_SOFT ? raw : DEX_EVA_SOFT + (raw-DEX_EVA_SOFT)*DEX_EVA_TAPER))/10; }
formulas.dexEvasionPct: function dexEvasionPct(dex, ml){ const d = Math.max(0, dex||0); return Math.min(45, Math.round(1000*d/(d + 25*Math.max(1,ml||1) + 100))/10); }
formulas.stormWardChance: function stormWardChance(r){ r = Math.max(1, r||1); return Math.min(0.25, 0.08 + 0.10*(Math.min(10,r)-1)/9 + 0.005*Math.max(0, r-10)); }
formulas.manaShieldPct: function manaShieldPct(r){ r = Math.max(1, r||1); return Math.min(0.75, 0.30 + 0.30*(Math.min(10,r)-1)/9 + 0.015*Math.max(0, r-10)); }
formulas.xpForKill: function xpForKill(ml, boss){ const base = xpForLevel(ml) / xpKillsPerLevel(ml) * XP_GLOBAL_MULT; return Math.max(1, Math.round(base * (boss ? XP_BOSS_MULT : 1))); }
